summary: Comprehensive testing of Distributed Cache Simulator. Backend (Express via FastAPI proxy) covered with 14 pytest tests across health, state, CRUD, lookup, eviction policy switching, capacity reduction with LRU eviction, replication factor, artificial latency, topology add/remove with key migration, TTL expiry, metrics shape, and logs/clear. Playwright UI tests covered initial render of stats-bar/hash-ring/node-blocks/ops-panel/config-panel/logs-panel, SET/GET-hit/GET-miss flows with last-result panel, add/remove node, policy LRU<->LFU switch, seed sample keys, reset cluster, hash-ring node labels, sliders presence, and absence of error-banner. All 14 backend tests pass; all UI checks pass.

issues: Recharts console warning: width(-1) height(-1) — chart still renders, but ResponsiveContainer initial mount logs a warning. Add explicit minHeight or a ResponsiveContainer wrapper height fix to suppress.

action_items: (Optional) Suppress Recharts warning by giving the MetricsCharts container an explicit min height or set width/height on ResponsiveContainer.
(Optional) /api/logs returns {logs: [...]} — current frontend already handles this; consider documenting the contract (some clients may expect a bare list).
critical_code_review_comments: Express server binds 127.0.0.1:8002 and is spawned by FastAPI lifespan — works, but a crash of the Node child won't be auto-restarted by supervisor (only the FastAPI parent is supervised). Consider a watchdog/respawn or log pipe for visibility.
Cluster.removeNode keeps min 1 node — UI 'remove' button on the last remaining node will silently no-op; consider disabling the button when nodes.size <= 1.

_rebalanceAfterTopologyChange iterates Map.values() while mutating sibling nodes via replicaDelete; current logic snapshots key list first which is correct, but worth a comment / unit test for safety.
HashRing uses md5 first 8 hex chars — fine for sim; comment in code says FNV-1a but implementation is md5. Update the comment.
Frontend page.jsx polls every 1.5s — fine for demo, but consider using SWR/React Query or server-sent events for cleaner state management.
seed_data_creation: Tests use TEST_ prefixed keys; cluster /api/reset is invoked between tests via autouse fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_cache_simulator.py reset cluster between tests via autouse fixture. Run with: cd /app && export $(grep -v '^#' frontend/.env | xargs) && python -m pytest backend/tests/test_cache_simulator.py -v. /api/logs returns {logs: [...]} object, not bare list. Hash ring has 40 vnodes per node so 3 nodes = 120 ring entries. Default capacityPerNode=8, policy=LRU, replicationFactor=1.
rca of the issue: No critical issues found. One test had to be adjusted because /api/logs returns {logs: [...]} (object) — the test now extracts the list. Frontend already handles this contract correctly via api.logs() and l.logs in page.jsx.
